consequence.statement: Flux controllers now dynamically adjust the Go runtime's processor thread limits to respond to available system resources, which may improve CPU utilization and performance in containerized environments.

assertion.statement: The Go runtime in Flux can now dynamically set GOMAXPROCS to adapt CPU resource utilization at runtime.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the evidence names a runtime behavior feature (GOMAXPROCS) but does not identify a specific subject family (e.g., whether this is an env-var, cli-flag, feature-gate, or protocol-behavior); the text describes what was enabled but not the operational object that controls or represents it; applicability: the evidence does not specify whether this feature is enabled by default, conditional on a flag/gate, opt-in, or applies to all workloads; whether it affects only controllers, all Flux components, or specific deployments is not stated
